ranking_ingest_next.effort: small (same Socrata exporter, one new table)
ranking_ingest_next.first_test: ISSUE-type license -> renovation permit or sign permit at the address within 365 days vs the same address's own earlier window; split by business activity.
ranking_ingest_next.why: Already in our warehouse as the current-active file only. The full history (1.21 million license terms since 2002-01-02) separates ISSUE (271,166) from RENEW (921,838) and change-of-location (C_LOC, 16,443) applications, with application-created and issue dates. That is the one free Chicago feed that shows a new business before it opens, and the food-license backtest (restaurant build-out about 90 days ahead of the license) shows the method works.

ranking_ingest_next.effort: medium (parse addresses from titles, join to permits by address/PIN)
ranking_ingest_next.first_test: Reclassification introduced -> new-construction or renovation permit >= $100k at the address; measure lead time vs permit issue date.
ranking_ingest_next.why: Zoning reclassification ordinances (1,487 since 2015-07, address and zoning application number in the title) are filed in Council months before a permit exists. This is the only machine-readable pre-permit trail for large Chicago projects that was reachable; the City's Plan Commission and ZBA web pages were not reachable from our client.

ranking_ingest_next.effort: small for the CSV (done); medium to productize PDF header extraction
ranking_ingest_next.first_test: Approved permits -> subcontractor/equipment-related permits at the facility address in the following 2 years (join approval letters to Chicago permits by address).
ranking_ingest_next.why: The Chicago-area analog of the Georgia case: 1,692 projects listed 2011-2026, staff reports and permit approval letters carry project cost, facility, city, permit holders and a description that names equipment. Volume is small (about 100 projects a year statewide) but costs in the sample run from $0.25 million to $645 million; buyers would be medical-equipment sellers and healthcare GCs, which we have no customer for yet. Needs one PDF library if cost is wanted.

ranking_ingest_next.first_test: Buying-plan item -> posted bid -> award; check lead time and whether bidders are repeat winners (relationship graph).
ranking_ingest_next.why: The only forward-looking public-work pipeline found in the data: Cook County's Buying Plan (planned solicitations), then bid tabulations (who bid, what price), then awards; Chicago contracts add 189,023 vendor contracts. Directly feeds Track 2 (GC open-door scores, subcontractor intelligence) and costs nothing.

ranking_ingest_next.first_test: New carriers (add_date in last 90 days) with power_units >= 5 as a weekly list; no backtest possible (no history).
ranking_ingest_next.why: 20,715 FMCSA-registered carriers with a Chicago physical address, with power units, drivers, add_date (new carriers) and MCS-150 update date. A clean, current B2B list for fleet-service sellers; a separate market from contractors, so rank depends on the founder's buyer choice.

ranking_ingest_next.first_test: New air-pollution-control permit -> mechanical/electrical permit at the address; ECHO NAICS to find industrial prospects.
ranking_ingest_next.why: Chicago's own air-permit analog of TCEQ: 67,886 City environmental permits (29,805 'AIR POLLUTION CONTROL PERMIT') plus 4,845 active Cook County air-program facilities in EPA ECHO. Useful as an industrial-site master list and a trigger for boiler/generator/spray-booth service; the Illinois EPA permit application list itself is only a search application.

ranking_ingest_next.first_test: New organizational NPI or dental/medical license with a Chicago practice address -> build-out permit within 180 days.
ranking_ingest_next.why: Healthcare and professional new-practice detection: IDFPR licenses (4.46 million rows with original issue dates; ODbL licence needs attribution and share-alike for derived databases), IDPH hospital/ASTC/dialysis directories (207 hospitals, 156 ASTCs), and NPPES enumeration dates. Medium signal for build-out and equipment sellers; mostly individuals, so match by practice address only.

ranking_ingest_next.first_test: Pre-certified ADU application -> building permit at the address; wait for 12 months of history.
ranking_ingest_next.why: 616 ADU preapproval applications since 2026-03-31, the only Chicago application-stage permit data found; too small and too new to backtest, but it is a real pre-permit feed for residential GCs and is trivial to ingest.
